title: spectio/synthetic-scenarios pipeline parameters
description: Synthetic three-stage pipeline with gate points and failure injection for Spectio tests

input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: The samplesheet the pipeline reads and where it writes its results.

input.description: Samplesheet: a CSV file with the columns sample, group, replicate and n_reads.
input.help_text: Left unset, the pipeline reads data/samplesheet.csv next to its directory: 12 samples in the groups ctrl, A and B.

outdir.description: The output directory, relative to the launch directory or absolute.

scenario_options.title: Scenario
scenario_options.description: How much work the synthetic data makes: the fan-out of ALIGN and the number of samples.

chunks.description: ALIGN tasks per sample: SPLIT cuts each sample's reads into this many chunks.
chunks.help_text: 0 is dynamic: one chunk per 100 reads, so a sample of 400 reads gets 4. The test profile sets 2.

scale.description: Above 1, adds (scale - 1) x 12 synthetic ctrl samples X0001… of 400 reads each, to stress the fan-out.

seed.description: Seed of the synthetic reads: the same seed gives the same reads and results.

failure_injection.title: Failure injection
failure_injection.description: Make one process fail, to watch a failure, a retry or a resume.

fail_mode.help_text: exit: exits 1. oom: killed as by an out-of-memory kill (exit 137), every attempt. oom_once: the same on the first attempt only, so the retry succeeds. oom_real: really allocates fail_gb GiB, for a scheduler's memory limit to kill. timeout: sleeps past the time limit. flaky: exits 1 on the first attempt only. Exit 137, a time limit and flaky are retried, at most twice.

fail_process.description: The process that fails. Nothing fails while it is empty or fail_mode is none.

fail_sample.description: Fail only the task of this sample (such as S03), or of this group for COMPARE (such as A); empty: every task of the process.

resources.title: Resources
resources.description: Limits of each task: 1 CPU and 512 MB, times the attempt.

time_limit_s.description: Time limit of a task's first attempt, in seconds; a retry gets twice as much, then three times.
time_limit_s.help_text: The timeout scenario lowers it, so that fail_mode timeout is killed quickly.

python_image.description: The task image of the docker and k8s profiles.
